name: Cloud
description: Self-hosted family cloud storage: Go backend, SvelteKit 5 frontend, SQLite, Docker Compose and Caddy.

name: Portfolio
description: This site: Astro with Svelte islands, built with Docker and served by nginx behind Caddy on my home server.

name: hackathon-4best-backend
description: Legacy backend sketch from the TeamGreen4All hackathon (1st place): MVC structure and the SQLite data model.

name: p2-sam-backend
description: Project SAM: REST API backend for a municipal support platform (Node.js, Express, MySQL, MongoDB). Best WebPII Project 2025/26.

name: p2-sam-automated-tests
description: Automated test suite for Project SAM, run against the deployed system: Selenium acceptance checks, Postman/Newman API collections and JMeter load tests. Two contributors.

name: PlanIt
description: Client-only travel planner with a gamification layer. ESMAD Best Project 2024/25.

name: Arcadia
description: 2D canvas game in two phases, a platformer and a camera-based AR phase. I built the platformer phase.

name: cg-threejs
description: Computer Graphics coursework: a 3D Tamagotchi in Three.js with Rapier physics. A pet hatches from an egg, runs on a state machine (idle, eating, playing, sleeping, ragdoll), reacts to microphone input and has three camera modes.

name: pw1-eco-tracker
description: b.green, a family sustainability tracker for the Programação Web I course: energy and CO2 tracking for household appliances plus a gamification layer of tasks, XP, streaks, badges and rewards. Vue 3, Pinia, Tailwind. Team of three.

name: mosaic
description: Small productivity dashboard in Vue 3, TypeScript and Pinia, with a timer, tasks, flashcards with a flip animation and a PDF reader. Built with Tailwind; mostly UI, with no backend or persistence.
